summary: YSX Tech Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 8, 2026, reporting the resignation of directors Weiqiang Zheng and Xuanjun Yang effective May 26, 2026, due to personal reasons with no disagreements cited. To fill vacancies, the board appointed Jing Li and Mei Wang as directors effective June 8, 2026; Mr. Li was also appointed Co-CEO. Ms. Wang qualifies as an independent director and audit committee financial expert. The filing discloses no special situation beyond routine board changes.
